lines.t:
How skilled the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> is at handling <c:ffff00>actions<c>.
There are 6 <c:ffff00>skills<c>: <c:ffff00>Striking<c>, <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>, <c:ffff00>Support<c>, <c:ffff00>Heal<c>,
<c:ffff00>Block<c> and <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>.
Using actions of a skill a certain number of times
raises its level (max 99). The sum of the 6 is the
<c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>.
A high level speeds up <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>. Striking
and {{shooting}} raise <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c>; the others raise
<c:ffff00>{{defend}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{evade}}<c>.
